def avg_rate(series):
    rates = []
    for i in range(1, len(series)):
        dt = series[i][0] - series[i-1][0]
        dv = series[i][1] - series[i-1][1]
        rates.append(dv / dt)
    return f"{sum(rates)/len(rates):.2f}"
